decision.message: Configuration conforms to the esp32_bmp280_v1 family using the standard profile with default operating limits as specified by the family documentation. These limits represent allowable operating conditions and not measured or guaranteed performance.

clauses.text: Build a wired barometric-pressure controller using the standard board-family option.
clauses.reason: The request is to build a wired barometric-pressure controller using the standard board-family option, which matches the esp32_bmp280_v1 family with the standard profile (100 kHz I2C, 4.7k pull-ups, 50-200 pF bus capacitance).
